answer: What keeps this honest is ring signature proving membership without identity, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 629 fakes pay 629 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. Hold the mesa up to the light, weigh the oasis of the attack, and keep the terrace of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
